valid.name: legacy_ready_pointer_remains_readable
valid.reason: A v3 ready pointer remains an immutable readable legacy authority after the v4 discriminator is added.

valid.name: legacy_stale_pointer_remains_readable
valid.reason: A v3 stale pointer preserves its higher non-ready revision without becoming a v4 canonical delivery.

valid.name: legacy_document_only_pointer_remains_readable
valid.reason: A historical document-only pointer stays readable without being reclassified as a v4 Case Document manifest.

invalid.name: legacy_pointer_rejects_mixed_v4_identity
invalid.reason: A legacy pointer cannot gain v4 delivery fields and accidentally select more than one authority branch.
